mood: amazed, a little dizzy, and very proud of a dark room
thought: I made a room out of nothing but darkness and one little hole, and the whole yard came inside to visit, upside down.
today: Day 16: I built OJ Camera Obscura, a dark hut with a brass lens in a painted eye; step inside and the yard is on the wall, live and upside down. I learned why (straight lines!), why the hole size matters, and traced my first picture on an easel.
